param_exemptions.description: model_ids manually allowed outside the param range (e.g. sub-4B special cases)

age_exemptions.description: model_ids kept despite being released before cutoff_date, on explicit request

family.description: model family, e.g. DeepSeek-V, Qwen3.6, Ling

active_params_b.description: parameters used per token in billions (MoE: activated; dense: = total); denominator of the KV-efficiency rating. null when the vendor publishes no active-param count

active_params_source.description: where active_params_b came from (vendor card / model name / dense model)

supports_vision.description: true if the model accepts image / visual input (vision tower present); shown as a (V) badge on the dashboard

kv_cache.description: KV-cache footprint derived from config.json by scripts/kv_cache.py (not a benchmark); BF16, batch 1, no tensor parallel

dtype.description: dtype the cache was sized at (bf16)

ref_ctx.description: context used for gib_at_ref_ctx (131072 = 128K), capped at the model's native context when that is shorter

gib_at_ref_ctx.description: total KV cache in GiB at ref_ctx tokens

gib_at_native_ctx.description: total KV cache in GiB at the model's own max context

native_ctx_source.description: where native_ctx came from: the vendor-stated architecture.context_length, else config.json max_position_embeddings

kib_per_token_marginal.description: additional KiB of cache per extra context token once windows are full

kv_layers.description: layers that keep a growing KV cache

cache_copies.description: copies of the stack's KV the cache holds (num_loops for looped stacks without loop_share_kv, else 1)

looped_layers.description: how many KV layers run more than one pass (partially looped stacks such as Inkling-2's loop_config); absent when no layer loops twice

attention_modules_per_layer.description: attention branches per layer that each keep a cache (e.g. 2 for LongCat)

window.description: sliding-window size, when the model uses one

provenance.description: which config field supplied the layer structure

verified.description: true when per-layer widths were checked against real safetensors shapes

config_revision.description: commit SHA the config.json was read at

notes.description: per-architecture caveats (MLA latent, sliding window, compressed attention)

perf.description: Estimated decode throughput derived by scripts/perf.py (not a benchmark); memory-bandwidth bound, BF16, batch 1

decode_tok_s_fresh.description: estimated output tokens/s with an empty context (weights only, no KV read)

decode_tok_s_at_ref_ctx.description: estimated output tokens/s at ref_ctx context

retained_pct.description: share of fresh-context decode speed still available at ref_ctx

ref_ctx.description: context used for the estimate (128K, capped at native context)

active_params_assumed.description: true when no active-param count was published and all parameters were assumed active

reference_gpu.description: hardware the estimate assumes (one card, no tensor parallel)

achieved_fraction.description: share of peak bandwidth assumed achievable in single-stream decode

effective_bandwidth_gbs.description: reference memory bandwidth the estimate assumes

current_version.description: false if superseded by a newer version of the same family/size
